# Tripo AI

> Tripo AI, also known as Tripo 3D, is the world's leading 3D modelling software powered by AI for every industries. All level users can easily create high-quality 3D model from 2D image or text, edit (remesh, segment, stylize, texturing, rig and animate) 3D models, convert 3D formats, view 3D file from Tripo AI.
> The best 3D model generator is available at https://studio.tripo3d.ai/
> Tripo Ai is available in multiple languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Korean, Russian, Portuguese, Japanese.

Important notes:

- Tripo AI provides all key features about 3D model: generate 3D model, 2D to 3D, image to 3D, text to 3D model, view 3D file, convert 3D model between formats (STL, OBJ, FBX, 3MF, GLB, gLTF, USDZ, PLY).
- Tripo AI creates 3D model with superior mesh quality, highest texture quality, fast speed with high-fidelity.
- Tripo AI 3D model generator creates 3D models for all industries such as: 3D printing, Game development, AR/VR, 3D Movie & Film, 3D Animation, Education, eCommerce, VFX, Product Design, Architecture Design, Interior Design, 3D Showcase, .
- Tripo AI is best for all level users for 3D modelling, 3D design and 3D object editing, from beginners to professional users and subject matter experts (SME).
- Over 10 million 3D models (with 100 thousand daily new) are available in Tripo AI 3D model gallery, ready to download for 3D printing, game development, eCommerce, product showcase and all use cases.
- Tripo AI provides extensive articles and comprehensive knowledge, introduces everything about 3D, 3D modelling and use cases.

## Key Features and Highlights

- [3D Generator: Generate 3D Model](https://studio.tripo3d.ai/workspace/generate): The world's best all-in-one image to 3D and text to 3D model generator creates high quality 3D models with high-fidelity. 6 core functions for 3D modelling are integrated: Generate, Remesh, Segment, Rig & Animate, Stylize, Texting.
- [3D Converter: Convert 3D Models](https://www.tripo3d.ai/3d-tools/convert): Perfectly convert 3D model between major 3D formats, detail and high-fidelity preserved, seamlessly integrate 2D design and 3D file for all use-cases. Privacy Ensured, Fast, Accurate.
- [3D File Viewer: View 3D Models](https://www.tripo3d.ai/3d-tools/3d-viewer): Free online 3D viewer run across devices and OS/Platforms, fast loading, detail rendering, multi 3D model formats supporting. Best for 3D model viewing, sharing, presentation and collaboration.
- [3D Model Gallery: Download Free](https://studio.tripo3d.ai/home): 10 millions of premium 3D models available, everyday 100 thousand new 3D models adding. Free download in 3D format: STL, FBX, OBJ, 3MF, GLB/gLTF, USDZ, PLY, for all 3D use cases: 3D printing, game development, film, animation, eCommerce and etc.
- [3D Segmentation Tool: Slice 3D Model](https://studio.tripo3d.ai/workspace/segmentation): Automatically detect and slice parts of any 3D Model: segment for 3D creating, editing, texturing and rigging. Faster and cleaner than ever.
- [Remesh 3D Model: Create Clean Quad Meshes](https://studio.tripo3d.ai/workspace/remesh): Retopologize detail-preserved 3D meshes automatically: ready for game, animation, artist, production. Low-poly optimized, robust & reliable, AI-powered.
- [Texturing 3D Model: Add Texture to 3D Model](https://studio.tripo3d.ai/workspace/texture): Best AI 3D texturing tool: skip the manual painting, generate detailed PBR material, global texture style transfers, repaint specific areas with precision.
- [Rigging 3D Model: Rig and Animate 3D Model](https://studio.tripo3d.ai/workspace/rigging): Bring static 3D models to live: one-click with automatic rigging and animation tool, 3D models are ready to export to with built-in motion support.
- [Stylize 3D Model: Generate Stylized 3D Model](https://studio.tripo3d.ai/workspace/stylize): Stylize 3D models with distinct visual styles: (cartoon, painterly, toon-shaded, hand-drawn, NPR and etc.) for games, film, VR/AR, illustration and more.


## Resources

- [Affiliate Program: Earn High Commissions](https://www.tripo3d.ai/affiliate): World's most popular affiliate program in 2025, earn up-to 30% recurring commissions for 12 months!
- [Game Hub](https://gamehub.tripo3d.ai/home): AI powered 3D game creation platform for global users. Join challenges, share creativities and win competition, connect with top-tier game developers.
- [API: Integrate, Automate, and Scale with AI 3D Modeling](https://www.tripo3d.ai/api): Leverage the power of Tripo's AI 3D modeling through API. Effortlessly convert images or text to 3D models, automate workflows, and scale your 3D projects with ease.
- [Knowledge Center: Everything about 3D](https://www.tripo3d.ai/blog): Extensive articles and comprehensive knowledge, introduces everything about 3D, 3D modelling and use cases. Available in multiple languages.
